name: browser_agent_create
description: Create or switch to a named page/agent. Each named page is independent — use this to run parallel automation flows.

name.description: Unique name for the agent page.

name: browser_agent_list
description: List all named agent pages and their URLs.

name: browser_agent_remove
description: Remove and close a named agent page.

name.description: Name of the agent to remove.

name: browser_agent_switch
description: Switch the active page to an existing named agent.

name.description: Name of the agent to switch to.

name: browser_assert
description: Validate page state: element existence/text, visibility, URL, or gated JavaScript. Returns PASS/FAIL without breaking the flow. Consolidates the former assert_visible, assert_text, and assert_url tools. type=js requires HELA_BROWSER_ALLOW_EVAL=true.

target.description: CSS selector for element/visible/text, URL pattern for url, or JS expression for js.

expected.description: Expected text for type=text or optional text for type=element.

name: browser_back
description: Navigate back in history.

name: browser_batch_answer_quiz
description: Batch answer multiple quiz questions in a single tool call. Navigates through pages, selects answers, and optionally submits. Handles radio and checkbox questions. Returns results with errors.

answers.description: Array of answers. Each entry: {q: <questionIndex>, option: <optionIndex>} or {q: <questionIndex>, options: [<indices>]} for checkboxes.

q.description: 0-based question index on the current page

options.description: Array of indices for checkbox questions

submitAfter.description: Click submit button after answering all questions.

nextSelector.description: CSS selector for the "Next" button. Auto-detected if not provided.

submitSelector.description: CSS selector for the "Submit" button. Auto-detected if not provided.

name: browser_cache_stats
description: Return statistics about the action selector cache (hit count, entries, stale entries). Read-only.

name: browser_check
description: Check a checkbox or radio.

name: browser_clear
description: Clear an input field.

name: browser_clear_intercepts
description: Remove all active request intercept rules.

name: browser_clear_mocks
description: Remove all network mock routes and restore normal behavior.

name: browser_clear_recording
description: Clear the current session action recording. Call before a workflow you want to capture as a test.

name: browser_click
description: Click by ref, visible text, CSS selector, or x/y coordinates. Supports nth/index match, left/right/middle button, single/double click, and smart selector fallbacks. Consolidates the former click_text, click_nth, click_ref, double_click, and right_click tools.

selector.description: CSS selector. Supports smart retry fallbacks.

nth.description: 0-based match index for selector or text.

count.description: Click count; use 2 for a double click.

name: browser_close
description: Close the browser session and clear state.

name: browser_console_messages
description: Return captured browser console messages and page errors (last 100). Useful for debugging — check for JS errors after interactions. Read-only.

maxLines.description: Maximum messages to return. Defaults to 100 (buffer size).

name: browser_dialog
description: Set how the active page handles its next JavaScript dialog. Call before triggering the dialog. The default accepts alerts and dismisses confirms, prompts and beforeunload dialogs.

action.description: Action to use for the next dialog.

promptText.description: Text to enter when accepting a prompt.

name: browser_dismiss_popups
description: Click visible close or reject controls in common popups and report their labels.

name: browser_download_click
description: Click an element (by ref) that triggers a file download, intercepts the OS file dialog, and saves the file to the local workspace.

ref.description: The ref ID of the element that triggers the download.

savePath.description: Absolute path to save the downloaded file. If omitted, saves to the current working directory with the suggested filename.

name: browser_drag
description: Drag from source to target.

name: browser_emulate
description: Emulate network conditions, CPU throttling, geolocation, locale, timezone, and color scheme. Locale also sets navigator.language, navigator.languages, and the Accept-Language header; the reply reports the language the page actually sees.

networkProfile.description: Standard network throttling profile to apply.

cpuThrottlingRate.description: CPU throttling rate multiplier (e.g. 2 for 2x slowdown, 4 for 4x slowdown). Use 1 or null to disable.

name: browser_evaluate
description: [R3 Privileged] Execute arbitrary JavaScript in the page context and return the result. Requires HELA_BROWSER_ALLOW_EVAL=true. Supports async/await, multi-statement scripts, and passing serializable data via args.

script.description: JS expression or statement block. Use `return` to return a value. May use `await`. Receives `args` as the first parameter.

args.description: Serializable value passed into the script as `args`.

name: browser_export_state
description: Export the current page state (URL, title, headings, text, interactive elements, cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, optional AX tree) as a JSON file. Use to create a reproducible snapshot for sharing with other agents, debugging, or replay. Defaults to exports/state-<timestamp>.json.

outputPath.description: Absolute path for the JSON file. Defaults to exports/state-<timestamp>.json.

includeAxTree.description: Include the full accessibility tree (significantly larger output).

name: browser_extract_schema
description: Extract structured data from the page matching a JSON schema. Provide a schema object with property names and descriptions. Reads JSON-LD (application/ld+json) and itemprop microdata first, then HTML tables, and only falls back to the keyword heuristic for properties those sources cannot resolve. More reliable than text extraction for structured data (prices, tables, forms, product info).

schema.description: JSON Schema object describing the shape to extract. Each property should have a "description" hint for where to find it on the page.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to scope the extraction to a specific element.

name: browser_extract_table
description: Extract data from an HTML table into JSON.

header.description: Whether the first row is a header

name: browser_fill_form
description: Fill multiple form fields at once. Keys accept a browser_observe ref, a bare name/id, or a CSS selector. Set typeAware=true to auto-detect input types (date, number, email, tel, url, select, checkbox, radio, file, contenteditable) and format values with the right Playwright method — much more reliable for structured forms than raw fill.

data.description: Key-value pairs of field: value. Each key may be a ref number from browser_observe, a bare field name or id, or a CSS selector.

submit.description: Whether to press Enter after filling

typeAware.description: Detect input type and format values automatically.

name: browser_forward
description: Navigate forward in history.

name: browser_generate_playwright_test
description: Generate a standalone Node.js Playwright script from the recorded actions. Call browser_clear_recording first to capture the starting URL. Run the generated file with node and have Playwright and Chromium installed.

outputPath.description: Optional absolute path to save the .spec.js file.

name: browser_get_captured_apis
description: Retrieve all API responses captured by browser_intercept_api. Returns structured JSON data.

pattern.description: Optional filter pattern to match against captured URLs.

name: browser_get_content
description: Restricted to browser or JavaScript-rendered content; prefer hela-enzyme extract_content for static pages. Extract page content as markdown, text, visible text, HTML, or accessibility tree. Consolidates the former get_text, get_html, get_visible_text, get_page_markdown, and get_accessibility_tree tools.

selector.description: CSS selector to scope extraction. Required for format=text.

all.description: For format=text: read all matching elements.

maxLines.description: For format=text: max elements returned when all=true. Default 100.

maxLength.description: For format=markdown/axtree: max output chars. Default 5000.

name: browser_get_cookies
description: Get cookies for the active page. Values are redacted by default; set includeValues:true to see them and allDomains:true to read the whole profile (both must be justified by the caller).

allDomains.description: Return the whole profile jar instead of the active page only.

name: browser_get_state
description: Capture the current page state: URL, title, headings, text blocks (text plus a textBlocks array), interactive elements (with ref numbers, including checked state and name for checkboxes/radios), AX tree, popups, CAPTCHA status, and any active mock/intercept rules. Auto-saves snapshot for browser_state_diff. Pass screenshot=true to also include a visual screenshot — only do this when elements may be hidden from the AX tree (canvas, shadow DOM, iframes, visual-only widgets) or when layout context is needed.

screenshot.description: Include a screenshot. Default false — only pass true when visual context is needed (canvas, iframes, hidden-from-AX elements).

mark_elements.description: Set-of-Mark (SoM): If true, draws numeric badges over all interactable elements on the screenshot. The numbers match the `ref` IDs in the returned state, allowing LLMs to visually locate elements for clicking.

name: browser_handle_captcha
description: Detect and handle CAPTCHA. Default: clicks checkbox, detects challenge type, returns immediately. Image: returns screenshot + prompt for agent to solve visually via browser_solve_captcha_grid. Audio: set audio=true to attempt whisper solve (with timeout param). Verify: set verify=true to check if solved. Agent is never blocked — can always use browser_screenshot or other tools between calls.

verify.description: Check if CAPTCHA was already solved.

audio.description: Attempt audio challenge solving via local whisper.

name: browser_health
description: Check browser health: context alive, page responsive, page count, active URL, evaluate latency, and the number of active mock/intercept rules (mockRouteCount). Read-only. Use to diagnose crashes, zombie contexts, unresponsive pages, or mocks a session forgot to clear.

name: browser_highlight
description: Draw a colored border around an element for visual debugging. Useful before taking screenshots to verify element location.

durationMs.description: How long to show the highlight (ms)

name: browser_hover
description: Hover over an element.

name: browser_image_analyze
description: Analyze a dedicated image with HeLa Cytosol visual intelligence. Provide exactly one imagePath, imageUrl, or imageBase64. Mirage returns VLM scene understanding, OCR, object detection, segmentation, relations, or schema-based decisions without requiring an active browser page. Every box is returned twice: bbox normalised 0–1 and bboxPx in pixels against image.width × image.height, so browser_click and crops can use bboxPx directly.

imagePath.description: Local image path inside the configured workspace roots.

imageUrl.description: HTTP(S) image URL. Private hosts, credentials, unsafe schemes, and excessive redirects are rejected.

imageBase64.description: Base64 image bytes, optionally prefixed with a data:image/...;base64, header.

operation.description: Describe the image or extract values matching schema.

sections.description: Describe sections to return, such as scene, objects, text, relations, or reasoning.

fields.description: Object fields to return, such as bbox (normalised 0–1, mirrored as bboxPx), score, mask, or description.

schema.description: Non-empty extraction schema used when operation=extract.

maskFormat.description: Optional mask output format, such as polygons or bitmap.

name: browser_intercept
description: Intercept network requests matching a URL pattern. Use to block ads/trackers, mock API responses, or inject headers. Rules persist for the session until browser_clear_intercepts is called.

pattern.description: URL glob pattern (e.g. "**/api/users*") or exact URL.

action.description: "block" aborts the request. "mock" returns a synthetic response. "modify" passes through with extra headers.

status.description: HTTP status code for mock responses.

body.description: Response body for mock (string or object — objects are JSON-serialized).

headers.description: Headers to inject (mock: sets response headers; modify: merges into request headers).

name: browser_intercept_api
description: Capture API responses matching a URL pattern. Stores responses in memory for later retrieval. Use to extract quiz data, form options, or any XHR/fetch response without DOM scraping.

pattern.description: URL pattern to match (glob or regex). E.g. "**/api/**", "**/exam*"

action.description: "start" begins capturing. "stop" stops and returns all captured. "get" returns captured without changing state.

reloadPage.description: If true, reload page after starting capture to trigger fresh API calls.

name: browser_intercept_list
description: List all active request intercept rules.

name: browser_list_dialogs
description: List the last 100 JavaScript dialogs on the active page with their type, message and action.

name: browser_list_sessions
description: List all saved session files in the sessions/ directory with name, size, cookie count, origin, and modified time. Read-only.

name: browser_list_tabs
description: List all open browser tabs.

name: browser_load_session
description: Load a previously saved session. Restores cookies and, if the session was saved with includeStorage=true, also restores localStorage and sessionStorage.

name: browser_mock_network
description: Mock API responses for frontend testing. Intercepts matching URLs and returns synthetic data without touching the backend.

name: browser_navigate
description: Navigate to a URL. Retries automatically on network failure. Auto-switches to DuckDuckGo if Google shows CAPTCHA.

retries.description: Number of retry attempts on failure.

retryDelay.description: Base delay in ms between retries (multiplied by attempt number).

name: browser_network_requests
description: Return captured network requests and their response status/timing (last 100). Useful for verifying API calls, detecting failed fetches, or inspecting what URLs are being hit. Requests answered by a mock/intercept rule are marked [MOCKED pattern] and carry mocked:true plus matchingPattern, so synthetic traffic is never mistaken for a real backend response. Read-only.

filter.description: Optional URL substring to filter results.

statusMin.description: Only return requests with status >= this value (e.g. 400 for errors).

mockedOnly.description: Only return requests answered by a mock/intercept rule.

realOnly.description: Only return requests that reached the network (excludes mocked ones).

maxLines.description: Maximum requests to return. Defaults to 100.

name: browser_new_tab
description: Open a new browser tab.

name: browser_observe
description: Return only interactable elements (buttons, inputs, links, selects) without a screenshot. Each element gets a stable `ref` number. Use before planning an action to enumerate available targets with minimal token cost — then act with browser_click(ref=...) or browser_type.

name: browser_ocr
description: Extract text from a screenshot or code block using OCR (Tesseract.js). Use for reading code images, CAPTCHAs, or any visual text that is not accessible via DOM. When text regions are available, lines[].bbox is normalised 0–1 and lines[].bboxPx is the same box in pixels, against image.width × image.height.

selector.description: CSS selector to screenshot (e.g. ".code-block"). If omitted, screenshots full page.

preprocess.description: Image preprocessing for better OCR accuracy.

returnImage.description: Also return the preprocessed image as base64 under imageBase64.

name: browser_parallel_execute
description: Execute actions on multiple named pages concurrently. Returns results from all pages.

actions.description: Actions to execute sequentially on this page

timeout.description: Max time per task in ms.

name: browser_performance
description: Return Core Web Vitals and browser performance metrics for the current page using CDP. Includes LCP, CLS, FID estimates, navigation timing, and resource counts. Read-only.

name: browser_press
description: Press a keyboard key.

name: browser_print_to_pdf
description: Print the current page to a PDF file. Returns the saved file path.

outputPath.description: Absolute path to save the PDF. Defaults to a timestamped file in the pdfs/ directory.

name: browser_record_macro
description: Control macro recording. Start recording user actions, stop and get the recorded script, or clear the recording buffer.

name.description: Name for the macro (used in export/save).

format.description: Format for stop or export. Both json and actions produce a replayable JSON action array.

save.description: On stop or export, save under user_data/macros/ and return the path.

name: browser_reload
description: Reload the current page.

name: browser_replay_macro
description: Replay a recorded macro or a list of actions. Can replay from JSON actions or a saved macro file.

actions.description: Array of action objects to replay. Each: {type, args}

macroName.description: Name of a saved macro to replay from user_data/macros/.

dryRun.description: If true, log actions without executing.

name: browser_resize_page
description: Set viewport width and height dynamically on the active page.

name: browser_save_session
description: Save the current session with a name. Saves cookies by default; set includeStorage=true to also capture localStorage and sessionStorage (needed for sites that store auth tokens in Web Storage instead of cookies).

name: browser_screenshot
description: Take a screenshot. Pass mark_elements=true to draw numeric badges over all interactable elements on the screenshot (Set-of-Mark).

mark_elements.description: Set-of-Mark (SoM): Draws numeric badges over interactable elements. The numbers will correspond to refs from observeInteractable.

name: browser_scroll
description: Scroll by direction and amount, to a selector or coordinates, or incrementally to trigger lazy loading. Consolidates the former scroll_to and smart_scroll tools.

mode.description: Scroll mode. Inferred from selector/x/y (to) or steps (lazy); defaults to by.

name: browser_search
description: Restricted to visual browser workflows (not general factual lookups; prefer hela-enzyme google_search). With scope "tools" it searches the local tool catalogue by name; otherwise it opens DuckDuckGo results.

query.description: Web query or exact or partial browser tool name.

scope.description: Search the tool catalogue or navigate to DuckDuckGo.

name: browser_select
description: Select an option in a dropdown.

name: browser_select_by_index
description: Select a radio button or checkbox by its 0-based index within a group. Use for quiz questions or radio groups where text matching is unreliable.

selector.description: CSS selector matching the radio/checkbox group (e.g. "input[name=q5]")

index.description: 0-based index of the option to select.

indices.description: For checkboxes: array of 0-based indices to check.

name: browser_set_agent_profile
description: Set the agent behavior profile.

name: browser_solve_captcha_grid
description: Click image CAPTCHA grid tiles by index (1-based, 1-9 for 3x3 grid). Use after browser_handle_captcha returns an image challenge. Call browser_handle_captcha again to verify result.

indices.description: 1-based tile indices to click (e.g., [1, 3, 5] for tiles 0, 2, 4 in the grid).

action.description: Action to take after clicking tiles (only verify supported).

name: browser_start_trace
description: Start recording a detailed Playwright trace including screenshots, snapshots, and network events.

screenshots.description: Whether to capture screenshots during tracing.

snapshots.description: Whether to capture DOM snapshots during tracing.

name: browser_state_diff
description: Compare the last two AX tree snapshots (saved automatically by browser_get_state). Returns structured diff: URL/title changes, new/removed headings, element changes, popup and captcha status transitions.

name: browser_stop_trace
description: Stop recording trace and save zip file. Defaults to exports/trace-<timestamp>.zip.

outputPath.description: Absolute path for the zip file. Defaults to exports/trace-<timestamp>.zip.

name: browser_switch_tab
description: Switch to a specific tab by index.

name: browser_switch_to_new_tab
description: Switch to a newly opened tab or wait for one. Returns its URL, title, and tab index.

urlPattern.description: Optional URL pattern to match the new tab. If not provided, switches to most recent new tab.

timeout.description: Max wait time in ms for new tab to appear.

name: browser_type
description: Type text into a field with optional human-like delay.

name: browser_uncheck
description: Uncheck a checkbox.

name: browser_upload
description: Upload a file to an <input type="file"> element. Provide absolute file path(s).

filePath.description: Absolute path to file. Comma-separated for multiple files.

name: browser_visual_analyze
description: Analyze the current page or a selected element with HeLa Cytosol visual intelligence. Mirage downloads and caches its local model on first use, then returns scene, object, text, relation, mask, or structured extraction results. Every box is returned twice: bbox normalised 0–1 and bboxPx in pixels against image.width × image.height.

operation.description: Describe the image or extract values matching schema.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to analyze only that element. Without it, analyze the current viewport.

sections.description: Describe sections to return, such as scene, objects, text, relations, or reasoning.

fields.description: Object fields to return, such as bbox (normalised 0–1, mirrored as bboxPx), score, mask, or description.

schema.description: Non-empty extraction schema used when operation=extract.

maskFormat.description: Optional mask output format, such as polygons or bitmap.

name: browser_wait
description: Wait for time, selector, URL, page load, network idle, DOM change, or SPA navigation. Consolidates the former wait_until_stable, wait_for_load, wait_for_selector, wait_for_url, wait_for_navigation, and wait_for_change tools.

condition.description: What to wait for. navigation waits for a URL change/pattern or selector after an action.

target.description: Selector for selector/change, URL substring or regex: pattern for url/navigation.

attribute.description: Attribute to watch for condition=change (default: textContent).

name: execute_command
description: Execute commands on remote hosts or locally. Returns a JSON object with 'command', 'exitCode', 'stdout', and 'stderr'. Commands are validated for dangerous patterns. Output is truncated if exceeding size limits. Rate limited per session.

host.description: Host to connect to (optional, if not provided the command will be executed locally)

username.description: Username for SSH connection (required when host is specified)

session.description: Session name (1-64 alphanumeric chars, underscores, hyphens). Defaults to 'default'. Reuse to persist state.

command.description: Command to execute. Validated for dangerous patterns unless ENABLE_COMMAND_VALIDATION=false.

workingDirectory.description: Working directory for command execution. Validated to exist for local commands.

useRtk.description: Whether to apply RTK token optimization and rewriting (default: true). Set to false for interactive commands or sudo.

name: terminal_cat
description: Restricted to remote SSH targets. Read remote file contents safely; use hela-membrane read_file for local files.

host.description: Remote host (required; local reads must use hela-membrane read_file)

username.description: Username for SSH (required if host provided)

tail.description: If true, reads the end of the file (like tail)

lines.description: Number of lines to read if using tail (like -n)

name: terminal_grep
description: Search for a pattern in files safely on remote or local hosts.

username.description: Username for SSH (required if host provided)

name: terminal_ls
description: List directory contents safely on remote or local hosts. Avoids shell quoting issues.

username.description: Username for SSH (required if host provided)

name: terminal_session_close
description: Close and disconnect an active terminal session, releasing its session slot. Accepts a session name (e.g. 'default', 'build'), session key (e.g. 'local-default'), or 'all' to close all active sessions.

session.description: Name or key of the session to close, or 'all' to disconnect all sessions

host.description: Remote host for remote sessions (optional, omit for local)

name: terminal_session_list
description: List all active local and remote terminal sessions, showing session keys, working directories, active environment variables, last activity timestamps, and capacity.

name: transfer_file
description: Transfer files between local machine and remote hosts via SFTP, or copy files locally. Supports upload, download, and local copy operations with size limits and validation.

source.description: Source file path. For uploads: local path. For downloads: remote path. For local copy: source path.

destination.description: Destination file path. For uploads: remote path. For downloads: local path. For local copy: destination path.

direction.description: Transfer direction: 'upload' (local to remote), 'download' (remote to local), or 'local' (local copy)

host.description: Remote host (required for upload/download, omit for local copy)

username.description: Username for SSH connection (required for upload/download)

overwrite.description: Overwrite destination if it exists (default: false)

name: archive_files
description: Create archive from files

name: compare_files
description: Compare two files and show differences

name: copy_file
description: Copy file from source to destination

name: create_directory
description: Create directory with optional recursive creation

name: delete_file
description: Delete file or directory

force.description: Force deletion even if path doesn't exist

name: extract_archive
description: Extract archive to destination. Reports extracted and skipped entries; path-traversal entries are rejected and listed with a reason.

name: find_files
description: Find files matching a pattern

name: get_directory_size
description: Get directory size recursively

name: get_file_info
description: Get detailed file information including metadata

name: list_directory
description: List directory contents with optional filtering and recursion

name: move_file
description: Move file from source to destination

name: read_file
description: Canonical local file read (use instead of hela-nucleus terminal_cat). Read file content with optional encoding and range

path.description: Path to the file to read

offset.description: Byte offset to start reading from

limit.description: Maximum number of bytes to read

name: search_in_files
description: Search for text patterns in files

filePattern.description: Glob pattern for files to search

contextLines.description: Number of context lines around matches

name: stop_watching
description: Stop watching a file or directory

name: watch_file
description: Watch file or directory for changes. Repeat calls return the events buffered since the previous call; stop_watching returns any remaining events.

name: write_file
description: Write content to file with optional encoding and directory creation

path.description: Path to the file to write

content.description: Content to write to the file

createDirs.description: Create parent directories if they don't exist

append.description: Append to file instead of overwriting

name: analyze_git_changes
description: Analyze bounded Git changes and untracked files in the current workspace. since defaults to "0": uncommitted changes against HEAD. Use "1" for the last commit, "N" for N commits ago, or a Git date

commit.description: Analyze one commit against its parent

since.description: How far back to diff: "0" = uncommitted changes (default), "N" = N commits ago, or a Git date. Mutually exclusive with commit

name: cache
description: Read or mutate the optional Redis companion cache. Select action: get, set, delete, or scan. Keys must use the mema:<category>:<name> namespace.

key.description: Required for get, set, and delete

name: create_mission
description: Create a mission or task in the fleet mission ledger for cross-agent coordination

title.description: Title or short summary of the mission

originAgent.description: Agent or user creating the mission (e.g. frea, mema, orchestrator, human)

targetAgent.description: Target agent assigned to execute (e.g. frea, mema, any, human)

payload.description: Arbitrary input data or parameters for the mission

name: delete_data
description: Delete records from memory.db table

database.description: Target store: active project database or central aggregate

name: execute_sql
description: Canonical memory-graph SQL inspection (use instead of hela-ribosome opencode_db). Execute raw SQL query on the project or central memory database (database: 'project' | 'central', default 'project')

database.description: Target store: active project database or central aggregate

name: export_data
description: Export memory.db table data to file

database.description: Target store: active project database or central aggregate

name: get_file_context
description: Get historical memory, recent modifications, linked tasks, and open bugs for a specific file path before editing or reading

filePath.description: Relative or absolute file path to look up

name: get_project_guidance
description: Invoke a project guidance framework to receive specialized instructions and checklists for specific workflows (e.g., project-setup, sprint-planning, code-review, etc.). This allows the AI to autonomously fetch and follow established project management protocols.

guidance_name.description: The name of the guidance framework to invoke.

arguments.description: Optional arguments required by the specific guidance framework.

name: get_session_context
description: Summarize active tasks, open bugs, recent changes, and blockers from project memory

scope.description: Use merged to include central memory

name: get_timeline
description: Get recent observations and project activity, newest first

since.description: Inclusive cutoff as an ISO date, Unix epoch number, or numeric string. Absolute numeric values below 100000000000 are seconds, otherwise milliseconds.

entityType.description: Filter by entity type (task, bug, decision, file, project)

name: harness_sessions
description: List local agent-harness session stores or sync their session metadata into the knowledge graph. Select action: list (read-only paths/presence/format notes) sync (redacted titles, summaries, timestamps; supports dryRun), or repair_timestamps (opt-in cleanup of legacy year +032971 markers; reports only unless apply is true).

since.description: Only sessions updated after this ms epoch

dryRun.description: Report what would sync without writing

apply.description: repair_timestamps only: write the repair (default false = dry run)

name: import_data
description: Import data from file into memory.db table

database.description: Target store: active project database or central aggregate

name: initialize_memory
description: Initialize the project memory system and database schema

name: insert_data
description: Insert records into a project or central memory table (database: 'project' | 'central', default 'project')

database.description: Target store: active project database or central aggregate

name: inspect_untrusted_text
description: Normalize untrusted text and detect common prompt-injection indicators

name: list_missions
description: Query missions from the fleet mission ledger filtered by status, agent, or target

claimedBy.description: Filter by agent currently claiming the mission

limit.description: Maximum number of missions to return (default: 50, max: 200)

name: memory_edit
description: Create or delete knowledge-graph entities, relations, and observations. Select the operation with action: create_entities, create_relations, add_observations, delete_entities, delete_observations, or delete_relations.

restore.description: create_entities only: clear a deletion tombstone so a deleted name can be created again

name: obsidian_vault
description: Control the optional Obsidian vault mirror (human-facing view of project memory). Select action: status, sync, rebuild, backfill, sync_central, sync_from_central, or dedup. Requires HELA_GENOME_OBSIDIAN_VAULT for vault actions.

name: open_node
description: Get detailed information about project entity/entities

names.description: Entity names to retrieve (supports single or batch)

name: query_data
description: Canonical memory-graph table query (use instead of hela-ribosome opencode_db). Query data from project or central memory tables (database: 'project' | 'central', default 'project')

database.description: Target store: active project database or central aggregate

name: read_graph
description: Read one bounded page of the project knowledge graph (default 500 entities). Follow nextCursor for more; use read_graph_stream for keyset streaming.

limit.description: Max entities and relations per page

offset.description: Rows to skip for single-store reads

name: read_graph_stream
description: Stream the knowledge graph with cursor pagination (500/page, updated_at DESC). Returns entities, relations, nextCursor.

name: search_feedback
description: Record which search source produced the result a caller actually used, so hela-enzyme can learn its per-source ranking priors instead of relying on static constants. Call once per source that returned results: used=true for the source whose result you used, used=false for sources you saw and passed over.

query_class.description: Query class the search was routed as

source.description: Search back-end this decision is about

used.description: true when a result from this source was used, false when it was seen and passed over

query.description: Optional query text; stored truncated to 512 characters

note.description: Optional short reason; stored truncated to 512 characters

name: search_nodes
description: Search project entities and relations with hybrid RAG and progressive disclosure

query.description: Search term for entities and relations

detailLevel.description: Progressive disclosure level (compact: token-saving IDs & previews, summary: recent observations, full: complete graph)

name: search_priors
description: Return the learned per-class search-source multipliers derived from search_feedback, with sample counts and which sources are still exploring (carrying the exploration bonus so an unsampled source can be picked again).

query_class.description: Limit the answer to one class; omit for all

name: security_scan
description: Scan for likely hardcoded credentials without exposing values, or scan a container image for HIGH/CRITICAL vulnerabilities with Trivy. Select action: secrets or container.

image.description: Container image reference for container scans

name: set_project_root
description: Switch the active memory database to the given absolute project path without importing or publishing memory

path.description: Absolute path to the project root

name: setup_pre_commit
description: Create a .pre-commit-config.yaml in the active project root and install the Git hooks, on demand. Requires pre-commit to be installed

name: sync_central_memory
description: Publish the active project graph to central memory, reconcile entity deletions in both stores, and report skipped entities and relations

name: update_data
description: Update records in memory.db table

database.description: Target store: active project database or central aggregate

name: update_mission
description: Claim a queued mission or reclaim an expired claim with status "claimed" and claimedBy. Claims are exclusive and expire 30 minutes after claimedAt. The current claimant can move a live claim to in_progress, then completed or failed. Cancel from any state, naming the claimant for an active claim. Operators can use action "requeue" to reset a mission and clear its claim and outcome.

action.description: Reset any mission to queued. Omit status, claimedBy, result, and error.

status.description: New mission status. Defaults to claimed when only claimedBy is supplied.

claimedBy.description: New claimant when claiming. Current claimant when starting, completing, failing, or cancelling an active claim.

result.description: JSON output. Required and non-null for completed. Optional for failed.

name: academic_search
description: Search academic papers and research documents

name: archive_org_search
description: Search archived web pages on Archive.org (Wayback Machine)

url.description: Original URL to search in archive

name: citation_formatter
description: Format citations in APA, MLA, or Chicago style

authors.description: List of author names as strings or structured given and family names

doi.description: DOI or DOI URL if applicable

name: content_deduplication
description: Deduplicate structured {title, url, snippet} items by canonical URL and title similarity; returns surviving objects plus a mergedFrom list as JSON

content.description: Array of content items to deduplicate

name: content_sentiment_analysis
description: Analyze sentiment of text content using built-in sentiment analysis

name: content_summarizer
description: Summarize content from multiple URLs, preferring og:description or the first main-content paragraph over raw body text

name: data_export
description: Export research data in various formats (JSON, CSV, Markdown)

data.description: Data to export. For CSV, pass an array of rows or an object with a rows array.

name: extract_content
description: Canonical content extraction: fetch a URL and extract its main content. Use hela-cytosol browser_get_content (format=markdown) only when client-side JavaScript is required.

name: fact_checker

claim.description: The claim or statement to verify

name: google_search
description: Canonical web search: Google Custom Search API. Use for factual lookups; prefer over browser-scoped search.

name: keyword_extraction
description: Extract key terms and topics from text content

maxKeywords.description: Maximum number of keywords to extract

name: multi_site_search
description: Search across multiple specific websites simultaneously and report a per-site result count

name: news_monitor
description: Monitor news and get alerts for specific topics

name: research_assistant
description: Multi-angle research assistant: runs several query variants, deduplicates identical results across them, and includes URLs

researchTopic.description: The main research topic or question

name: research_brief
description: One-call research brief: fans out to Google + Wikipedia in parallel, dedups cross-source overlap, ranks exact matches first. Replaces chaining google_search + wikipedia_search manually.

name: research_session_manager
description: Save, load, list, and delete research sessions stored on disk

sessionName.description: Session name (1–64 ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores, or hyphens)

name: search_analytics
description: Find relevant web sources in a date window and show Google matching page estimates when available

queries.description: Array of search queries to analyze

name: search_trends
description: Find relevant web and Hacker News evidence in a date window, with Google matching page estimates when available

topics.description: Array of topics to track trends for

name: url_metadata_extractor
description: Extract metadata from URLs including title, description, and basic info

name: wikipedia_get
description: Get Wikipedia content by title, page ID, or multiple titles. Use format=summary for a short extract, format=full for cleaned article text. Exactly one of title, pageId, or titles is required.

title.description: Page title (exactly one of title, pageId, or titles).

format.description: summary returns a three-sentence extract; full returns cleaned article text.

name: wikipedia_get_pages_in_category
description: Browse pages within a specific Wikipedia category

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to return

type.description: Type of category members to return

name: wikipedia_page_languages
description: Get the languages a Wikipedia page is available in

name: wikipedia_random
description: Get a random Wikipedia page

name: wikipedia_search
description: Search Wikipedia by text query, multiple queries, or coordinates. Exactly one of query, queries, or coord is required. Nearby searches honour radius (metres).

limit.description: Results per query (max 10), or nearby results (max 50).

name: brand_fetch_design_md
description: Download and return the DESIGN.md for a real brand (stripe, vercel, linear, notion, claude, tesla, etc.).

name: brand_list
description: List the curated local brand catalog (68 unique brands across 9 categories, 72 listings) grouped by category. For DESIGN.md retrieval beyond this list, use brand_fetch_design_md, which resolves the getdesign catalog.

name: design_audit
description: Audit design work. Select action: accessibility (25-check WCAG 2.1), slop (37-gate anti-pattern check), critique (6-axis quality score), or preflight (scan an existing project's design tokens and stack).

content.description: HTML/CSS required for slop and critique

project_path.description: Project root for preflight (defaults to MCP root)

name: design_tokens
description: Generate design tokens. Select action: theme (named theme or genre), custom (OKLCH paper/accent + fonts), css (vanilla/CSS Modules/SCSS/variables-only), or tailwind (complete tailwind.config.js).

theme_name.description: Named theme for theme action: Specimen|Atelier|Newsprint|Studio|Manifesto|Brutal|Terminal|Midnight|Bloom|Aurora|Cobalt|Coral|Hum|Garden|Sport|Carnival|Obsidian Kinetic|Tokyo Neo-Brutal|Atelier Craft

genre.description: Genre for theme action (ignored if theme_name is set)

font_display.description: Display font stack for custom action

font_body.description: Body font stack for custom action

font_mono.description: Optional mono font stack for custom action

style.description: Design system slug for css/tailwind actions (e.g. glass, minimal, material)

name: detect_genre
description: Detect the most appropriate design genre from a product description or brief. Returns one of: editorial, modern-minimal, atmospheric, playful, avant-garde.

brief.description: Product description, brief, or design request text

name: evaluate_style
description: Evaluates a product description against all design systems and returns ranked style recommendations with scoring. USE THIS FIRST before generate_rules. Takes a product context (e.g. 'automotive gaming mouse', 'enterprise dashboard', 'luxury ecommerce') and returns the best-matching style, palette, archetype, and a step-by-step workflow.

description.description: Product description or context (e.g. 'automotive gaming mouse', 'enterprise admin dashboard', 'luxury fashion ecommerce')

name: export_project
description: Export a complete project scaffold: tailwind.config.js, index.html, input.css, package.json, and component files. Returns all files as a structured manifest ready to write to disk.

name: generate_8state_component
description: Generate a complete 8-state component demo page (default, hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, error, success) for a given component kind. Returns a standalone HTML preview file with all states rendered.

name: generate_motion_snippet
description: Generate a ready-to-paste anime.js v3 animation snippet for a given motion category and design style. Returns CDN link, code snippet, usage hint, and reduced-motion note. Categories: entrance, micro, stagger, scroll, loader, transition, counter, typewriter, magnetic, text-split, smooth-scroll, marquee, noise-grain, clip-path-mask. All snippets include prefers-reduced-motion guards.

category.description: Animation category: entrance=page load, micro=button/chip interactions, stagger=list/grid reveal, scroll=IntersectionObserver-triggered, loader=spinner, transition=page transitions, counter=number counters, typewriter=text reveal

style.description: Design system (e.g. glass, neo-brutalism, claymorphism, material, minimal, etc.). Adjusts easing and duration to match the system's motion character.

engine.description: Animation engine to use. Defaults to motion.dev.

framework.description: Target framework (used by motion.dev engine). Defaults to react.

name: generate_rules
description: Generate design rules for a style + palette + optional archetype/hybrid. IMPORTANT: Run evaluate_style first to determine the best style for your product context. Only use this tool after evaluation confirms the style choice.

hybrid.description: Optional secondary system for hybrid mode

name: generate_template
description: Generate a full HTML starter page for a style + palette + archetype combination. IMPORTANT: Run evaluate_style first to determine the best style/palette/archetype for your product context.

name: get_component
description: Get a production-ready component snippet styled for a specific design system. Supports HTML (Tailwind), React (TSX functional component with typed props), and Vue 3 (SFC with script setup). IMPORTANT: Run evaluate_style first to confirm the style choice.

framework.description: Output framework (default: html). 'react' returns a TypeScript FC with typed props. 'vue' returns a Vue 3 SFC with script setup.

palette.description: Optional color palette for React buttons.

name: get_cross_cutting_rules
description: Get standalone cross-cutting design rules by category. Categories: icons, accessibility, motion, tokens, responsive, tailwind. Returns the rules as a formatted string.

name: get_ellis_ui_template
description: Fetch a complete Ellis UI design system (e.g. 'backup_dossier' or 'backup_gameboy'): design.md plus every HTML page (index, letter, note, slideshow). Pass page to fetch a single page instead.

design_name.description: The folder name of the design (e.g. backup_nutrition, backup_gameboy, backup_swiss_archival)

page.description: Optional HTML page filename to return alone (e.g. letter.html). Omit to return all pages.

name: get_reference
description: Return the full content of a reference document by name (e.g. 'ant-design', 'accessibility', 'design-tokens', 'getdesign-md').

name: list_ellis_ui_designs
description: List all 24 bespoke Ellis UI design templates as a compact index: name, title, concept, typography, palette, and available HTML pages. Use get_ellis_ui_template for the guidelines and page source.

name: list_installed_skills
description: Detect and list all installed skill submodules alongside this MCP. Shows which skills are available for standalone use and what capabilities they provide.

name: list_options
description: List all available design systems, palettes, archetypes, and valid hybrid combinations.

name: list_themes
description: List all available named themes, optionally filtered by genre. Each theme includes paper/accent OKLCH values, font pairing, and axis metadata for diversification.

name: logo_workflow
description: Logo-design workflow. Select action: audit, search, renderers, render, export_variants, concept_sheet, preview_sheet, presentation_board. Search queries the 1,432-mark library; render/export/board actions write files.

files.description: SVG file paths for audit, render, concept, or preview

query.description: Free-text words matched against file name, brand, subject, note, mood, industry, mark/symbol type, technique, geometry, type style, and other catalog fields. All terms must match.

format.description: Search output format (default json). JSON returns an array of hits or an object explaining zero matches.

keepWhite.description: Keep pure white in mono variants

only.description: Variant subset: black, white, mono, square, favicon, app-icon

name: palette
description: Fetch live palettes from Color Hunt, convert palette JSON into CSS/Tailwind/SCSS/Figma/Android/Swift, or generate light/dark/high-contrast/muted/vivid variants. Select action: fetch, convert, or variants.

colors.description: Hex colors required for variants, e.g. ["#3b82f6"]

name: stitch_screen_audit
description: Run a unified audit on a Stitch-captured HTML screen or file. Executes 25-check WCAG 2.1 static analysis, 37-gate anti-slop checks, and 6-axis craft critique.

screenHtml.description: Full HTML content of the captured screen

filePath.description: Path to a captured HTML file (e.g. .stitch/captured-dom.html)

genre.description: Design genre for scoped anti-slop checks (default: avant-garde)

name: validate_combo
description: Validate a style + palette + optional hybrid combination before generating rules.

name: execute_staged_refinement
description: [R3 Native Execution] Execute a technical Geometric Delta (Python code) provided by the Critic. Use this recursively until the Quality Score reaches 90+. WARNING: Runs with full Blender process privileges. Gated by HELA_PLASTID_ALLOW_CODE.

name: generate_modeling_plan

name: get_agent_instructions
description: Retrieve specialized persona instructions (planner/writer/debugger/critic).

name: get_api_docs
description: Advanced Blender Python API RAG: Get precise documentation, examples, and signatures.

identifier.description: fully-qualified name, e.g. 'bpy.types.Scene', or '*' for module list.

name: get_blender_helpers
description: Retrieve a list of high-level Python helper functions available in the Blender environment (e.g., setup_pbr, apply_subd).

name: get_blendfile_summary
description: Detailed summary of the .blend file (datablocks, missing files, linked libraries).

name: get_fast_feedback
description: Capture a low-resolution, high-speed Workbench screenshot for agent self-criticism.

name: get_modeling_patterns
description: Retrieve high-fidelity modeling blueprints (e.g., rounded corners, SubD topology).

name: get_object_details
description: Deep dive into an object's mesh, materials, modifiers, and animation status.

name: get_scene_summary
description: Comprehensive scene map: objects, collections, modes, and active selection.

name: get_screenshot
description: Capture high-speed viewport screenshot (returns base64).

name: navigation

name: render_output
description: Render the current scene or viewport.

name: save_blend
description: Save current Blender file or a copy.

name: app_current
description: Get the currently foregrounded app package name and activity.

name: app_install
description: Install an APK file on the device from the host machine.

apkPath.description: Absolute path to the APK file on the host machine

name: app_list
description: List installed packages on the device. Optionally filter by name or restrict to system/third-party apps. Use to find package names for app_start.

filter.description: Filter packages by name (partial match, case-insensitive)

system.description: true = system apps only, false = third-party only, omit = all

packageName.description: Package name to launch (e.g., 'com.example.app'). Prefix with '+' to force-stop the app first (e.g., '+com.example.app')

name: app_stop
description: Force-stop an app on the device.

name: app_uninstall
description: Uninstall an app from the device.

name: clipboard_get
description: Get the current clipboard content from the device. Uses scrcpy GET_CLIPBOARD when a session is active (works on Android 10+), falls back to ADB clipboard commands.

name: clipboard_set
description: Set the clipboard content on the device. Uses scrcpy SET_CLIPBOARD when a session is active (with optional paste flag), falls back to ADB clipboard commands.

text.description: Text to set in the clipboard

name: collapse_panels
description: Collapse all open panels (notification, settings) (requires active scrcpy session)

name: connect_wifi
description: Enable WiFi ADB and connect to the device wirelessly. Returns the connection address.

name: device_info
description: Get detailed info about a device: model, Android version, screen size, SDK level, battery level

serial.description: Device serial number. If omitted, uses the only connected device.

name: device_list
description: List all connected Android devices with their serial numbers, state, and model

name: disconnect_wifi
description: Disconnect from a wireless ADB device

name: drag_drop
description: Perform a drag and drop gesture from one point to another. Uses input draganddrop on Android 8.0+ (API 26), falls back to swipe on older versions.

name: expand_notifications
description: Expand the notification panel (requires active scrcpy session)

name: expand_settings
description: Expand the quick settings panel (requires active scrcpy session)

name: file_list
description: List directory contents on the device.

path.description: Absolute path to the directory on the device (e.g., /sdcard/)

name: file_pull
description: Pull a file from the device to the host machine.

remotePath.description: Path to the file on the device (e.g., /sdcard/myfile.txt)

localPath.description: Destination absolute path on the host machine

name: file_push
description: Push a file from the host machine to the device.

localPath.description: Absolute path to the file on the host machine

fields.description: Array of form fields to fill

name: input_text
description: Type text into the input field. Reports device context (screen, app, session). When submit=true, auto-detects and taps the send button. Optionally target a specific input field by text label, resource ID, or content description instead of auto-focus.

submit.description: Auto-tap send/submit button after typing (for chat/messaging apps)

elementText.description: Target a specific input by its label text (e.g. 'Full Name', 'City/Domicile')

elementId.description: Target a specific input by resource ID

elementContentDesc.description: Target a specific input by content description

name: long_press

name: screen_off

name: screen_on

description: Start recording the screen. Recording continues until screen_record_stop is called.

remotePath.description: Path on device to save recording

duration.description: Max recording duration in seconds (optional, device limit usually 180s)

name: screen_record_stop
description: Stop screen recording and optionally pull the file to the host.

pullToHost.description: Pull the recording to the host machine

localPath.description: Local path to save recording (only if pullToHost is true)

name: screenshot
description: Take a screenshot of the Android device screen. Returns the image as base64.

name: scroll
description: Scroll at the specified position. dy=negative scrolls UP (reveals content above), dy=positive scrolls DOWN (reveals content below). Use large values (e.g. -400, 500) for meaningful scroll distance.

dy.description: Vertical scroll: negative=scroll UP (reveal above), positive=scroll DOWN (reveal below)

direction.description: Scroll direction to find the element

name: shell_exec
description: Execute an arbitrary ADB shell command on the device and return the output. Use this for any device operation not covered by other tools.

command.description: Shell command to execute on the device

name: start_session
description: Start a scrcpy session for fast input control and screenshots. When a session is active, tap/swipe/text/screenshot are 10-50x faster. Requires scrcpy-server to be installed.

name: start_video_stream
description: Start an HTTP MJPEG video stream of the device screen and open a viewer window (ffplay). Starts a scrcpy session automatically if needed.

port.description: HTTP port for the MJPEG stream (default 7183)

name: stop_session
description: Stop the active scrcpy session. Tools will fall back to ADB commands.

name: stop_video_stream
description: Stop the HTTP MJPEG video stream and close the viewer window for a device.

name: swipe

name: tap

name: ui_dump

exactMatch.description: If true, text and contentDesc require exact matches

textToType.description: The text to inject into the field

text.description: Text content to search for to find the element

exactMatch.description: If true, text and contentDesc require exact matches

index.description: If multiple elements match, which one to tap (0-indexed)

name: ui_tap_element
description: Find a UI element by text, resource ID, class name, or content description, and immediately tap it. Smartly finds the nearest input field when targeting a label.

exactMatch.description: If true, text and contentDesc require exact matches

index.description: If multiple elements match, which one to tap (0-indexed)

preferInput.description: If true and matching a label, finds nearest input field instead

name: ui_wait_for_element
description: Wait for a UI element to appear on screen. Polls the UI until the element matches criteria or timeout is reached.

exactMatch.description: If true, text and contentDesc require exact matches

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait in milliseconds (default 15000)

name: version
description: Report which scrcpy version is being used by the MCP server. The version is detected from the SCRCPY_SERVER_VERSION environment variable, the scrcpy --version binary, or a built-in default.

name: wait
description: Wait for a specified number of milliseconds. Use between actions to wait for animations, page loads, or network responses.

name: agent_close
description: Close a tracked agent session, optionally also deleting the opencode session.

name: agent_create
description: Legacy tool. Agent creation is unsupported on opencode v2.

path.description: Directory for the agent file (defaults to global or .opencode/agent)

name: agent_fork
description: Fork an agent session (opencode run --session <id> --fork) into a new tracked branch session.

name: agent_info
description: Inspect an agent session: metadata, resolved opencode session id, and output preview.

name: agent_list
description: List menager agent sessions, optionally merged with live opencode session list.

maxCount.description: Max merged opencode sessions across tracked directories (default 20, max 50)

sessionId.description: Tracked menager session ID. Omit to resume the latest OpenCode session.

cwd.description: Working directory when sessionId is omitted (defaults to the server's working directory).

name: agent_spawn
description: Spawn an opencode agent run (opencode run) inside a managed PTY. Native multi-agent orchestration: each agent gets its own sessionId for routing follow-ups via agent_send/agent_fork.

prompt.description: Initial prompt for the agent (max 8000 chars)

cwd.description: Working directory for the agent run

format.description: OpenCode output format (JSON by default). Formatted output uses a unique suffix in the OpenCode title for routing.

share.description: Legacy option. Sharing is unsupported on opencode v2.

attach.description: Connect to a running opencode server URL (--server)

run_id.description: P0-B4: RunStore run id to link this agent to

step_id.description: P0-B4: RunStore step id to link this agent to

name: opencode_auth_list
description: List authenticated providers (opencode auth list). Read-only; names only, no secrets.

name: opencode_db
description: Legacy tool, restricted: direct session database inspection is unsupported on opencode v2. Use hela-genome execute_sql for the memory database.

name: opencode_export
description: Export opencode session data as JSON (opencode session export <sessionID>).

name: opencode_import
description: Import opencode session data from a JSON file (opencode session import <file>).

file.description: Absolute path to a session JSON file

cwd.description: Directory to run the import from. OpenCode re-homes the session to this project (defaults to the server's working directory).

name: opencode_mcp_list
description: List configured MCP servers and connection status (opencode mcp list).

name: opencode_models
description: List available models, optionally filtered by provider. Returns up to 50 complete rows and 8000 characters.

refresh.description: Legacy option. Unsupported on opencode v2.

verbose.description: Legacy option. Unsupported on opencode v2.

name: opencode_server_spawn
description: Spawn a long-running opencode server in a managed PTY. Use its URL as the attach input to agent_spawn. Waits a fixed startup window: status running means alive after that window, not ready.

name: opencode_session_delete
description: Delete an opencode session (opencode session delete <sessionID>). Standalone; agent_close also offers this.

name: opencode_stats
description: Token usage and cost statistics (opencode stats).

topTools.description: Show tool reliability and limit it to N rows

topModels.description: Show model usage and limit it to N rows

project.description: Filter by project ID, or use '.' for the current project

name: opencode_status
description: Check opencode CLI availability, version, defined agents, and tracked session counts.

name: session_close
description: Kills and removes an interactive PTY session managed by this server, freeing its memory. SSH sessions backed by tmux also get their remote window killed unless persistOnClose is set.

persistOnClose.description: SSH + tmux only: keep the remote tmux window alive so a later session_spawn({sessionId}) can re-attach to it.

name: session_hook
description: Awaits a specific regex pattern on the session stream with optional automated reply.

triggerPayload.description: Optional payload to write AFTER registering the hook to avoid concurrency deadlocks

name: session_info
description: Returns metadata and status for a specific session.

name: session_list
description: Lists all active and completed interactive PTY sessions managed by this server.

name: session_prune
description: Force deletes sessions (default: only 'exited' sessions).

description: Reads buffered output from the target session: the raw/stripped line buffer ('lines', default) or the rendered terminal screen ('screen').

mode.description: 'lines' (default) returns the ring buffer as text. 'screen' returns the @xterm/headless rendered frame as JSON — what a human would see — which is what TUIs, progress bars and full-screen apps actually need.

stripAnsi.description: lines mode: strip ANSI escape codes and replay carriage-return overwrites so each line shows its final rendered text (default true).

offsetLines.description: Read lines starting from this index

grepPattern.description: Filter read lines by regex pattern

includeScrollback.description: screen mode only: include rows that scrolled off the viewport (default false).

settleMs.description: screen mode only: wait up to this long for the output stream to go quiet before snapshotting. Immediate by default; a snapshot taken at the cap reports settled:false.

name: session_resize
description: Resizes the PTY terminal dimensions.

name: session_signal
description: Sends a POSIX signal to the target session process.

name: session_spawn
description: Spawns a new child PTY session, or re-attaches to a tracked one when 'sessionId' names an existing session.

sessionId.description: Re-use this id. An id already tracked by this server is an idempotent re-attach: the rendered viewport resets, local scrollback is kept, and a '[reconnected at <iso>]' marker is injected. Ignored args on re-attach.

persistOnClose.description: SSH + tmux only: leave the remote tmux window running when the session is closed or the server shuts down (default false).

terminalType.description: Set to 'dumb' to avoid TUI/cursor artifacts, or 'xterm-256color' for standard colors.

name.description: Optional logical name for this session

ttlMs.description: Optional Time-To-Live in milliseconds. Auto-closes session after it exits.

host.description: Optional [user@]hostname. When set, the session runs the system ssh binary as its transport and 'command' is ignored.

remoteCommand.description: Argv to run on the remote host (requires 'host'). Omit for an interactive login shell.

run_id.description: P0-B4: RunStore run id to link this session to

step_id.description: P0-B4: RunStore step id to link this session to

name: session_wait
description: Blocks and waits for a session to exit, returning its exit code.

name: session_write
description: Injects keystrokes, commands, or escape sequences into the session's standard input.

pressKey.description: Optional special key (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+D, Enter, Tab, Escape, ArrowUp, ArrowDown)

name: analyze_tool_chain_performance
description: Check tool availability and analyze dependencies. Duration and complexity are catalog estimates, returned as null when unavailable.

toolChain.description: Array of tool chain steps to analyze

id.description: Step ID, defaults to step_1, step_2, and so on

dependsOn.description: Prerequisite step IDs. Omit to depend on the preceding step, or pass [] to declare no explicit prerequisites.

outputMapping.description: Map parameters to previous outputs using stepId.outputKey. Each reference adds a dependency.

includeExecutionMetrics.description: Include estimated serial duration and dependency-based parallelization potential

name: analyze_tools
description: Lists discovered tools by server (category). Complexity is a catalog estimate or null when unavailable.

category.description: Filter by cell or server name

name: analyze_with_sequential_thinking
description: Analyzes complex workflows using sequential thinking

name: brainstorming
description: Generate creative ideas via a generative model (requires CHAINING_LLM_ENABLED with OPENROUTER_API_KEY; fails honestly without a key — no template ideas)

topic.description: The topic or problem to brainstorm about

includeEvaluation.description: Whether to include evaluation and prioritization

constraints.description: Array of constraints or requirements to consider

name: convert_time
description: Convert time between timezones

name: generate_route_suggestions
description: Generates optimal route suggestions for a given task

task.description: The task or problem to solve

name: get_current_time
description: Get current time in a specific timezone

name: get_prompt
description: Get a specific prebuilt prompt by ID

id.description: The ID of the prompt to retrieve

name: get_resource_set
description: Get a specific resource set by ID

id.description: The ID of the resource set to retrieve

name: get_skill
description: Load a skill file (SKILL.md by default) plus its manifest for agent context or harness use. Read-only; never executes skill scripts.

file.description: Optional relative file inside the skill, such as references/style-dna.md or scripts/vault.py

maxChars.description: Truncate body to this many characters

name: get_tool_chain_analysis
description: Summarizes discovered tools and recommends catalog matches for individual operations in the input.

name: list_mcp_servers
description: Lists all discovered MCP servers on the system

name: list_skills
description: List all discovered agent skills (name, description, files) from the local skills catalog. Read-only; never executes skill scripts.

name: llm_decompose_task
description: Decompose a complex goal into ordered subtasks with recommended tool categories. [Legacy compat API — routes via the Needle planner when MITOSIS_AGENT_ENABLED=true.]

task.description: The complex task or objective to decompose

name: llm_query
description: Execute a direct query using the internal LLM engine (OpenRouter/OpenAI compatible, disabled by default)

prompt.description: The prompt to send to the internal LLM

name: llm_suggest_route
description: Use LLM intelligence to score and rank optimal multi-tool execution routes. [Legacy compat API — prefer agent_run when MITOSIS_AGENT_ENABLED=true.]

name: llm_summarize
description: Compress verbose tool outputs, logs, or multi-step execution results

name: load_instruction
description: Loads a custom instruction from the repository

filename.description: Filename of the instruction to load

name: search_instructions
description: Searches custom instructions based on keywords in their descriptions

keywords.description: Keywords to search for in instruction descriptions

name: search_prompts
description: Search for prompts by keywords, category, or tags

query.description: Search query to match against prompt names, descriptions, categories, or tags

name: search_resource_sets
description: Search for resource sets by keywords, category, or tags

query.description: Search query to match against resource set names, descriptions, categories, or tags

name: search_skills
description: Search the skills catalog by keywords against names and descriptions. Returns ranked matches for chaining.

name: sequentialthinking
description: Think one step with the Mitosis agent: your thought is recorded as an observation in AgentState, Needle decides the next action (call_tool/revise/complete/escalate), and the result feeds the next step. Pass sessionId to continue a session.

nextThoughtNeeded.description: Whether another thought step is needed

task.description: Ongoing task this step belongs to (agent mode; defaults to the thought)

sessionId.description: Continue an existing agent session (agent mode)

execute.description: Execute a call_tool decision immediately (agent mode)

name: suggest_skill_chain
description: Plan a task with Needle over registry tools and attach skill recommendations per step (deterministic catalog match, labeled). Combines skills+tools into one executable chain.

task.description: The task to plan a skill+tool chain for

name: validate_tool_chain
description: Validate tool chains for correctness, dependencies, and potential issues. Checks for circular dependencies, tool availability, and parameter compatibility

toolChain.description: Array of tool chain steps with server name, tool name, parameters, and dependencies

checkCircularDependencies.description: Whether to check for circular dependencies

checkToolAvailability.description: Whether to verify tools exist on their servers

name: workflow_cancel
description: Request cancellation of a running workflow

name: workflow_orchestrator
description: Execute complex multi-server workflows across the MCP ecosystem with dependency management and error handling

description.description: Description of what this workflow does

steps.description: Array of workflow steps to execute

serverName.description: Name of the MCP server to execute on

toolName.description: Name of the tool to execute

parameters.description: Parameters to pass to the tool

dependsOn.description: IDs of steps that must complete before this step

outputMapping.description: Map outputs from this step to input parameters for dependent steps

retryOnFailure.description: Whether to retry this step on failure

failFast.description: Whether to stop execution on first failure

variables.description: Global variables available to all steps

name: workflow_status
description: Get the current status and step results of a workflow executed by workflow_orchestrator or agent_run

workflowId.description: Workflow identifier returned by workflow_orchestrator or agent_run

name: hela.update.apply
description: Apply the latest verified HeLa ecosystem snapshot. Requires confirm=true, preserves a rollback record, and requires a runtime/client restart afterward.

confirm.description: Explicitly authorize changing the managed installation.

name: hela.update.check
description: Read-only check for a newer HeLa ecosystem snapshot. Reports changed cells and never modifies the installation.
